name: @dumbass-ux/suite
description: Evidence-backed, screenshot-only UX audit skills for web, dashboards, and mobile web.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dumbass/runner && npm run build -w @dumbass/adapter-web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test tests/build.test.mjs tests/install.test.mjs tests/schemas.test.mjs tests/skills.test.mjs && node --test evals/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-drift.mjs && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.release:check: npm run validate && npm run test:browser && npm run test:package && npm run security:audit && node scripts/check-pilot.mjs
